scope: Standing Lalbagh Fort precinct: the Tomb of Bibi Pari, western mosque, Dewan-i-Aam with hammam, southern ramparts and the monumental southeast gate.

originalReview.notes: 2026 view gives the mausoleum profiles, oxidized central dome, corner turrets, old lime finishes, terracotta audience hall and the garden axes.

references.artist: Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Jeremy R. Boan

originalReview.notes: The 2026 official Navy photo shows the two-story audience hall with coral lime finish, shallow-curved Bengali roof, projecting eaves on short brackets, triple scalloped openings and lower pointed door recesses. Only the building is used.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla’s exact CC0 panorama is the primary exterior control. The official Navy photo supplies close wall and roof detail at the audience hall. Historic paintings were left out of current-state modeling.
